tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and irregular raw prefixes point to the archived coupled memory mechanism, but five rows are insufficient to identify its four parameters reliably. The extra fine trajectory batch supplies the needed observations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archived mechanism has four coupled parameters and explicitly requires at least eight rows; the current observations leave parameter identifiability ambiguous.
It targets the siphon branch rather than the history-dependent transient indicated by the pilot.
It is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity.
